decision_fill_chronology.decision: bar open timestamp plus exactly 300 seconds, after the M5 bar is complete
decision_fill_chronology.fill: the next source-record open for that pair at or after the decision timestamp, with source record ordinal strictly later than the decision bar
decision_fill_chronology.market_gap: the next observed executable record remains the fill/exit; elapsed wall time remains visible and financing uses it
decision_fill_chronology.max_age_unit: observed completed M5 holding bars, not wall-clock bars
decision_fill_chronology.terminal: all remaining inventory is forcibly liquidated at the final in-period completed bar executable BID/ASK close

exact_formula.direction_formula: LONG when EMA3_t-EMA12_t > 0, SHORT when it is < 0, and carry the most recent nonzero direction on exact equality
exact_formula.ema_formula: EMA_s,t=alpha_s*mid_close_t+(1-alpha_s)*EMA_s,t-1; alpha_s=2/(s+1); EMA_s is seeded by the arithmetic mean of the first s completed mid closes
exact_formula.emission_frequency: exactly one RAW_SIGNAL for each eligible completed bar after warmup
exact_formula.exact_zero_tie_break: carry the previous nonzero direction; if the first eligible bar is exactly equal, use LONG

size_and_caps.currency_exposure_basis: signed fixed-JPY-risk incidence by base and quote currency

warmup.ema12_seed: arithmetic mean first 12 completed mid closes
warmup.ema3_seed: arithmetic mean first 3 completed mid closes
